title: A Space plan Upgrade click and a Space plan trial start are both counted

source.ref: Funnel and onboarding audit 2026-11-27 (project thread: Audit funnels and onboarding for Fergal; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/K6WJF8sPmATEFjjDNCr3sh)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-27: commerce.checkout_started fires only on marketplace and ticket buttons; the Space plan billing page and space-plan-checkout never emit it. A trial-only Checkout Session completes with payment_status other than paid, and purchaseConversionFromSession returns null for it (lib/analytics/purchase.ts:48), with no event in lib/billing/space-subscriptions.ts either, so the first sale of the business cannot be measured from click to trial. Landing, sign-up start and return are covered by EMAIL-089; this row is the money end only.

verify.note: Passes once the consequence in the title holds.
